C1744.title: CCTV 315 Gala Exposes AI Model 'Poisoning' Industry Chain
C1744.summary: The CCTV 3.15 Gala revealed that service providers offer a service called GEO, allowing clients to inject advertisements into mainstream AI models through paid placements, making their products the AI's 'standard answers' and forming an industry chain that 'brainwashes' AI.
